contexts.text: By subtle deceit...
They supposed themselves to be so subtle that...
Evil Spirits who are more subtle than Spirits. Explained.
Most people suppose that those are enlightened who... can speak more subtly and acutely about these things.
For Spirits act more subtly than men. Explained... These were so subtle that...
As these Spirits were invisible, I supposed that they were as subtle, and yet evil... For those who are... subtle in their matters of business are such. Described.
There are Hells which are in a more subtle sphere. Explained.
He was one of the subtle evil Spirits, because he had indulged in thought more than in discourse. Described.
Whereas the men of our Earth see these things which have been written as subtle and elevated.

As in a solid consisting of these three degrees, in the centre of which are the most subtle parts, around this the parts less subtle, and in the extremes... parts compounded of the former, and thus grosser.
Seeds... are impregnated by the most subtle substances, which can have no other than a spiritual origin.
(The skin and its coats) imbibe the most subtle things of the world, and transmit them to the brain.
On the more subtle Spirits. General article.
They pride themselves on being able to be subtle...
A subtle proposition [put forth] by certain ones.
On the more subtle thought. Explained.
His ideas, which he supposed to be so very subtle that more subtle ones would be impossible - if he were to see one of them with a microscope, he would see it... larger than the whole Earth...
That the interior Spirits have a subtle perception. Explained.
On the more subtle evil Spirits in the line of the zenith, at various heights.
They are carried away by the cupidity of punishing anyone whatever in a subtle manner.
On a subtle veil. Explained.

They supposed that they were free because they were subtle, as if in what is purer... They were told that their Subtlest appears to them as if it were the Subtlest of all things, just as is the case with others... They disappeared with a kind of subtle veil into what was more subtle... SE 3123. a.
A vision concerning the more subtle magical things. Described.
There exhaled thence so much subtle poison that it excited the more deceitful Sirens.
The more subtle evil Spirits above the head inflowed into my thoughts...

At last there inflowed... the like still more subtle - so subtle that previously I had not perceived that subtlety, so that it was within the former subtle [influx]; and, when the intermediate Spirits perceived it, they wanted to seize on it... but they could not be otherwise than distinct; for those who were their most subtle ones could not enter into the more exterior subtle ones; nor these into the more interior subtle ones.
The most subtle... were those who had been sons of the Most Ancient Church... SE 3354.
As these were more subtle, they were in front, above... They who inflow subtly, and insensibly, were those who suppose such adulteries... to be holy.
They were greatly tortured; for they were thus let into more subtle ideas.
(Dippel) acted very subtly. Described.

Some (of the Dutch), when taken up into the sphere of the interior angelic Spirits, ... the speech of their ideas was so subtle that I marvelled; nay, they were so subtilized that I scarcely perceived it... for through the subtlety they almost vanished from my perception...
For the knee [denotes] that which is more subtle.
The deceitful over head... sometimes inflowed so subtly that I did not know it was from them... Today I observed how they inflow into the subtle thought of man...

They who supposed themselves to be most subtle... were reduced into such grossness that they could only speak very grossly... The punishment succeeded from the highest grossness to a less one, and thus to a more subtle one... so that they can be punished in their fallacious subtlety also.
That the evil who suppose themselves to be subtle, are grosser than all others. Explained.
Thus the subtle things of which they are composed are evil. Whereas they who are not subtle may be evil without, but not so evil within.
They were subtle Spirits placed in concealment. Described.
On the destruction of the subtle Spirits from the Mohammedans, Babylonians, and Reformed.
(Anthony of Padua) is a subtle Spirit. Described.
Ignatius... was subtle; but (seemed) to have been good.
On Genii and subtle Spirits. General article.
Who, from this subtlety... thinks that God is one?
For the Natural is gross... and the Spiritual is subtle...
They inflowed into my affections with such subtlety...
